comments.author: @movinginstereo44
comments.text:
A friend referenced this song in a post…
❤️
My ex-wife, during what turned out to be our very last conversation, just days before she died due to her addiction to alcohol… asked me if I had heard the album and specifically this song.
(Adele had released this album, “25” just 2 months before she passed.)
I kind of brushed it off at the time. Not knowing what she apparently knew.
Now, whenever I hear this song… I touch my heart and blow her a kiss to the sky.
Knowing now what she was saying and leaving me with.
❤️😔🌹
